instance.description: The name of the Spanner instance the IAM binding applies to.
instance.rationale: This is a required reference to the target Spanner instance. It does not directly introduce a security risk but must be correctly configured to ensure IAM bindings are applied to the intended instance.

member/members.description: Identities that will be granted the privilege in role. Can be allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers, user, serviceAccount, group, or domain.
member/members.rationale: Granting access to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers makes the Spanner instance publicly accessible, exposing all databases within it to unauthorized users. Only specific, trusted identities should be granted access.

role.description: The role that should be applied. Can be used per role with google_spanner_instance_iam_binding.
role.rationale: The role determines the level of access granted to the members. Overly permissive roles such as roles/spanner.admin should be avoided in favour of least-privilege roles to reduce the attack surface.

policy_data.description: The policy data generated by a google_iam_policy data source.
policy_data.rationale: Policy data defines the full IAM policy for the instance. Misconfigured policy data can grant excessive permissions or expose the instance to public access.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project field is optional and defaults to the provider project. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should be explicitly set to avoid applying IAM bindings to unintended projects.
